name: assetpanda/case-slider
title: AP Case Slider
description: Customer story slider: centred heading over one story at a time (quote, author, link beside a photo with an optional client logo), arrows, a progress line and dots. Live: the #ap-<page>-case section (.apg-case-*) on the solution pages and Help Desk, and #ap-gov-case on the industry hubs (sheets and markup ported). This block is an adapter — it holds no markup; it maps attributes to kit props.
